duplicate_groups.reason: Both workflows run CodeQL analysis with overlapping security coverage.
duplicate_groups.resolution_path: Keep the pinned advanced CodeQL workflow as canonical unless branch protection requires the legacy name; retire the duplicate after required checks are updated.

duplicate_groups.reason: Production, launch, and readiness workflows cover adjacent release-readiness checks.
duplicate_groups.resolution_path: Keep policy-driven prod-readiness as canonical and fold checklist-only evidence into release-gate artifacts before deprecating duplicates.

duplicate_groups.reason: Chaos workflows split smoke, engineering, and test coverage across separate triggers.
duplicate_groups.resolution_path: Preserve chaos-testing as the evidence-producing workflow and move lightweight smoke coverage into its matrix or scheduled profile.

duplicate_groups.reason: PR, test, mandatory-test, and verify workflows overlap on merge validation duties.
duplicate_groups.resolution_path: Keep branch-protected pr-checks canonical; retain the others only for distinct evidence until branch protection and reporting dependencies are reviewed.

duplicate_groups.reason: Security gates, security validation, and secret guardrails overlap on security posture validation.
duplicate_groups.resolution_path: Keep security-gates canonical and move unique secret guardrails into gate-secrets-readiness before deprecation.

duplicate_groups.reason: Layer 6 wrapper and dashboard metric drift workflows both guard Layer 6 drift surfaces.
duplicate_groups.resolution_path: Keep layer6-wrapper-drift as the canonical wrapper drift check and fold dashboard-specific metric assertions into one Layer 6 drift workflow before deprecation.
